doc.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007

title: Hearing the greats live in a Cleveland club
summary: He opened for Bill Evans, where he met Eddie Gomez, and heard Jimmy Smith, Miles, McCoy, Keith Jarrett and early Weather Report.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: I have, both of them, yeah. There was a great club in Cleveland that we would open for many acts, and I got to open for Bill Evans where I met Eddie Gomez and subsequently recorded with him later, and Jimmy Smith and so they all came through, and six nights, and we got to hear them. So everybody came through: Miles and McCoy and Keith Jarrett and the first version of Weather Report.
So this was a very enlightening time for me.
